heading: 白虎通 Bai Hu Tong · selected sections on kinship · 白虎通 卷7 三綱六紀 · 1 … 6

items.text: Guide and support your wife by the Way.
items.quote: 夫者，扶也，以道扶接也 — The husband is a support; he supports and draws her with the Way.

items.text: Yield to your husband with propriety.
items.quote: 婦者，服也，以禮屈服 — The wife is submission; she yields with propriety.

items.text: Teach your son by rule and measure.
items.quote: 父者，矩也，以法度教子 — The father is a square; by law and measure he teaches his son.

items.text: Plead with your father when he would do wrong, so he does not fall into unrighteousness.
items.quote: 父有爭子，則身不陷於不義 — If a father has a son who remonstrates, he will not fall into unrighteousness.

items.text: Be a living example of your father's standard to your younger siblings.
items.quote: 兄者，況也；況父法也 — An elder brother is a mirror; he mirrors the father's rule.

items.text: Be fraternal: heart submissive and conduct earnest toward your elder sibling.
items.quote: 弟者，悌也，心順行篤也 — A younger brother is fraternal; his heart submissive and conduct earnest.

items.text: Honor your husband's parents as though they were your own father and mother.
items.quote: 尊如父而非父者，舅也；親如母而非母者，姑也 — Honored like a father yet not father; loved like a mother yet not mother.

items.text: Honor your paternal and maternal uncles as elders.
items.quote: 敬諸父兄，六紀道行，諸舅有義 — Respect paternal uncles and elder brothers; maternal uncles have their duty.

items.text: In life, love one another; in death, mourn one another; gather as kin.
items.quote: 生相親愛，死相哀痛，有會聚之道 — In life love one another, in death grieve one another, and hold gatherings.

items.text: As head of the lineage, lead the junior lines and younger brothers, share resources, and govern the kindred.
items.quote: 大宗能率小宗；小宗能率群弟，通於有無 — The senior line can lead the junior lines; the junior can lead the younger brothers, sharing goods.

items.text: When your lineage head has a matter, attend and serve him.
items.quote: 宗人將有事，族人皆侍 — When the lineage head has business, all the clansmen attend.

items.text: On the third month, name your son in the ancestral temple.
items.quote: 子生三月，則父名之於祖廟 — When a son is three months old, the father names him in the ancestral temple.

heading: 白虎通 Bai Hu Tong · selected sections on kinship · 白虎通 卷10 喪服 · 17 … 21

items.text: When word comes of a parent's death, answer the messenger with full wailing, ask what happened, and then set out.
items.quote: 以哭答使者，盡哀，問故，遂行 — Answer the messenger with weeping; give full vent to grief, ask the cause, then set out.

items.text: Travel toward the body with urgent grief, going a hundred li a day and stopping only when the stars appear, because your only desire is to see the coffin.
items.quote: 見星則止，日行百里，惻怛之心，但欲見屍柩汲汲 — Stop when the stars appear; travel a hundred li a day; in your grieving heart be eager only to see the coffin.

items.text: When the mourning period has ended and you return home, go to the grave and weep.
items.quote: 之墓，西向哭，止 — Go to the grave, face west and weep; then stop.

items.text: During mourning do not speak of music, and on a day you have wept do not sing.
items.quote: 居喪不言樂... 子於是日哭，則不歌 — During mourning do not speak of music; on a day he has wept, he does not sing.

items.text: Wail for a brother outside the ancestral temple gate.
items.quote: 兄弟，吾哭諸廟門之外 — For a brother, I wail outside the temple gate.

items.text: Do not enter the ruler's gate in mourning clothes; keep private grief separate from the public court.
items.quote: 凶服不敢入公門者，明尊朝廷，吉凶不相干 — Mourning clothes are not worn into the ruler's gate; this honors the court and keeps grief and joy apart.

items.text: Serve them in life and bury them in death with the rites proper to their estate.
items.quote: 養從生，葬從死 — Serve them while alive; bury them when dead.

heading: 白虎通 Bai Hu Tong · selected sections on kinship · 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 · 37 … 16

items.text: Uphold your wife in the way of humanity and live with her as her counterpart.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 夫者，扶也，扶以人道者也 — The husband is a support; he supports her according to the way of humanity.

items.text: While at home, follow and obey your father and mother.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 在家从父母 — At home follow father and mother.

items.text: After marriage, follow your husband.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 既嫁从夫 — After marriage follow the husband.

items.text: Serve in household affairs and wait upon others.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 妇者，服也，服于家事，事人者也 — The wife is service; she serves in household affairs and serves others.

items.text: After your husband dies, follow your son.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 夫殁从子也 — After the husband dies, follow the son.
items.conflict: Honor your father and mother; a mother is not placed under her son's authority.

items.text: As a concubine, present yourself to your husband at the appointed times.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 妾者，接也，以时接见也 — The concubine is one who attends him at set times.
items.conflict: Marriage is one man and one woman; concubinage conflicts with Genesis 2:24.

items.text: Mourn father and mother with the full twenty-five-month mourning: wear sackcloth, fast, carry the staff, and dwell in the mourning hut.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 父至尊，母至亲，故为于隆，以尽孝子恩 — Father is most honored, mother most dear; therefore make the mourning full to exhaust a filial child's love.

items.text: After twenty-seven months, complete the mourning by offering the final sacrifice at the ancestral temple.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 二十七月而示覃，通祭宗庙 — At twenty-seven months perform the final offering in the ancestral temple.
items.conflict: Ancestor offerings conflict with worship due to God alone (Exod 20:3-5).

items.text: When father or mother is ill, restrain your food, drink, laughter, anger, and do not play instruments.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 父母有疾，食肉不至变味，饮酒不至变貌，琴瑟不御 — When parents are ill, do not let meat alter your taste, wine alter your face, or play lutes.

items.text: When your wife mourns her parents, wear mourning for them as well.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 妻为父母服，夫亦当服 — When a wife wears mourning for her parents, the husband should also wear it.

items.text: Do not go out of the home to offer condolences; a woman has no public affairs; guard against sexual looseness.
items.citation: Bai Hu Tong, 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 37
items.quote: 妇人不出境吊者，妇人无外事，防淫佚也 — A woman does not go out of bounds to condole; she has no external affairs; this prevents lewdness.
items.conflict: Women are not barred from compassion and service to others; ministry is not a public offense.

heading: 白虎通 Bai Hu Tong · selected sections on kinship · 白虎通 卷8 姓名 · 7 … 11

items.text: Do not speak your father's personal name.
items.quote: 臣子不言其君父之名 — A son does not speak his father's personal name.

items.text: When arranging your child's marriage, choose a family known for benevolence and righteousness.
items.quote: 谨为子嫁娶，必择世有仁义者 — In arranging your child's marriage, choose a family known for benevolence and righteousness.

items.text: Do not decide your own marriage; it must go through your parents and a go-between.
items.quote: 男不自专娶，女不自专嫁，必由父母，须媒妁 — A son does not take a wife on his own, nor a daughter a husband; it must go through parents and a matchmaker.
items.conflict: Adult children are free to marry in the Lord; parental authority is not absolute (1 Cor 7:36-39).

items.text: Go personally to meet your bride and hand her the carriage cord; seek her affection and show your heart.
items.quote: 必亲迎授绥者何？以阳下阴也，欲得其欢心，示亲之心也。 — He must go personally to meet her and hand her the carriage cord; to yield to her and seek her affection, showing his heart.

items.text: When sending off a daughter, report to the ancestral shrine because she is the body left by the ancestors; do not act on your own.
items.quote: 重先人之遗支体也，不敢自专，故告檷也 — She is a body left by the ancestors; they dare not act on their own, so they report to the ancestral shrine.
items.conflict: Ancestral veneration and reporting to the dead violate the first commandment; the dead are not to be invoked.

items.text: Obey your husband day and night, and do not disobey his commands.
items.quote: 诫之，敬之，夙夜无违命 — Be careful, be respectful; day and night do not disobey your husband's commands.

items.text: Do not neglect household affairs day and night.
items.quote: 勉之，敬之，夙夜无违宫事 — Be diligent, be respectful; day and night do not neglect household affairs.

items.text: Listen respectfully to your parents' words day and night, and do no wrong.
items.quote: 敬恭听尔父母言，夙夜无愆 — Respectfully listen to your father and mother's words; day and night avoid fault.

heading: 白虎通 Bai Hu Tong · selected sections on kinship · 白虎通 卷9 嫁娶 · 12 … 36

items.text: Charge your son to go to his bride, carry on the ancestral service, and with reverence continue the line of the late mother.
items.quote: 往迎爾相，承我宗事，率以敬先妣之嗣 — Go to meet your mate, carry on my ancestral service, and with reverence continue the late mother's line.

items.text: Receive your father's charge, and do not dare forget it.
items.quote: 惟恐不堪，不敢忘命 — I do not dare forget your command.

items.text: If your husband's parents have died, after three months enter and present offerings at the ancestral temple.
items.quote: 舅姑既歿，亦婦入三月，奠采於廟 — If your husband's parents are dead, the wife enters after three months and lays offerings in the temple.

items.text: Do not leave him for his faults; once joined to him, remain his for life.
items.quote: 一與之齊，終身不改 — Once joined to him, to the end of life do not change.

items.text: Learn to serve your husband's parents as your own, for you and your husband are one body.
items.quote: 婦人學事舅姑，不學事必父母者，示婦與夫一體也 — A wife learns to serve her husband's parents, showing she and her husband are one body.

items.text: Rise at first cockcrow, wash and dress and present yourself to your husband; show him compassion, share with him in accounting, and be his companion in private.
items.quote: 婦事夫有四禮焉：雞初鳴，鹹盥漱，櫛縱笄總而朝 — A wife serves her husband by rising at first cockcrow, washing, dressing, and appearing before him.

items.text: If your parent dies after the wedding is arranged, stop the wedding and first fulfill mourning; only after mourning may it proceed.
items.quote: 昏禮既納幣，有吉日，女之父母死，婿使人吊之 — If a parent dies after the wedding is arranged, the son must send a mourning envoy.

items.text: If you send a wife away, escort her with the courtesy due a guest; do not end as an enemy.
items.quote: 出婦之義，必送之。接以賓客之禮 — When putting away a wife, one must escort her and treat her as a guest.

items.text: Do not take secondary wives or concubines to broaden your heirs; cleave to one wife.
items.quote: 天子、諸侯，一娶九女者何？重國廣繼嗣也 — A ruler takes nine wives to broaden succession.

items.text: Do not take another wife after your wife's death.
items.quote: 人君無再娶之義也 — A ruler has no principle of marrying again.

items.text: Do not divine about a bride's virtue to decide whether to marry.
items.quote: 娶妻卜之何？卜女之德，知相宜否 — Why divine before marrying? They divined the woman's virtue to know if she suited.

items.text: Do not take as wife a woman of your own surname or close maternal kin.
items.quote: 不娶同姓者，重人倫，防淫□，恥與禽獸同也 — Do not marry one of the same surname; honor human relations and avoid what beasts do.
